author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
We are riding along the last stretch of the Pamir Highway, another 400 km along the Afghan border before we turn westwards to Tajikistan's capital Dushanbe. On our way we could gaze far into Afghanistan, passed by villages, saw the Taliban flags and watching ordinary people and herders living the life on the Afghanistan side of the border. 
Join us on this epic journey through the Pamirs between Tajikistan and Afghanistan.
